decisions.title: System Tray Quick Action Callout Tip

shipped: System Tray Quick Action Callout Tip
lessons_next: Specific wait-step status indicators (+14.7% measured) and diagnostic screens (+6.1% measured) were helpful, with predictions (+14.0% and +3.5%) slightly too low, though other wait-info additions and new screens showed no clear effect.

Selected layout redesigns (Story Scroll Path Discovery Layout: +9.5% measured) and hints (System Tray Quick Action Callout Tip: +9.6% measured) were helpful, and predictions (-1.0% and +2.0%) were significantly too low.
Most other redesigns, layout changes, and hints showed no clear effect, with positive predictions (+1.0% to +12.0%) consistently being too high.
Deferring account sign-in (-7.3% measured) and path outcome copy optimization (-6.6% measured) significantly harmed performance; predictions (+15.0% and +1.5%) were far too high.
Copy refinements showed no clear effect (or significantly harmed performance), and predictions were generally too optimistic.
